# CAS-ViT-T

Classification · `casvit-t_224x224` · DX-APP Python example

Classification model, evaluated on ImageNet.

**Input** 224 × 224 × 3 · **Dataset** ImageNet · **License** MIT · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

![CAS-ViT-T output](result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models casvit_t
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/image_classification/casvit/casvit-t_224x224/casvit-t_224x224_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/casvit-t_224x224.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/person_pair
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target casvit-t_224x224_sync   # once
./bin/casvit-t_224x224_sync \
  -m assets/models/casvit-t_224x224.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/person_pair
```

## Accuracy

|---|---:|

| Q-Lite | 82.05 (−0.25) |
| Q-Pro | 82.70 (+0.40) |
